title: Saturating Counter
statement: Design a 4-bit saturating counter that increments on each clock edge when enabled, but stops at 15 instead of wrapping. A synchronous reset should return the count to zero. This is useful in control systems where overflow must be prevented.
module_signature: module saturating_counter(input clk, input rst, input en, output reg [3:0] count);
behavior: If en is 1, count increments until 15 and then holds.
If en is 0, count remains unchanged.
All state updates occur on the rising edge of clk.
rst is active-high and synchronous unless the problem statement explicitly says otherwise.
Use non-blocking assignments in clocked always blocks.
Outputs must never depend on uninitialized x/z state after reset.
When rst is asserted on a rising edge, registered outputs reset to their documented initial values.
constraints: Do not allow the count to wrap around after reaching 15.
hint: Check the current value before incrementing and hold at the limit.
